phase: P8 step 1: iPadOS host in the simulator
build: NTSD_PORTABLE=1 NTSD_IOS=1 swift build --triple arm64-apple-ios17.0-simulator --sdk <iPhoneSimulator 27.0 SDK> --product NTSDiOS (Xcode toolchain); NTSDCore/NTSDRuntime built unchanged for iOS
app: tools/crossplatform/ios_app.py: NTSDiOS.app (executable, Original* resource folders at the app root, OriginalMusic, Info.plist for an iPad-only landscape scene app, ad-hoc signed), installed with simctl on iPad Air 13-inch (M4), iOS 27 simulator

host.view: one UIView showing the presented framebuffer as a CGImage, resizeAspect, nearest
host.windows: virtual windows centred on the scene's screen, no frame metrics
host.input: touches as left-button mouse messages through the fit rect; hardware keyboard via UIKey.keyCode (USB HID usage) and OriginalHIDKeys, the table now shared with SDL
host.text: CoreText masks with UIFont.systemFont(13, .bold), the same code as the macOS masks: frames are byte-identical to AppKit's
host.audio: AVAudioSession (ambient) + AVAudioEngine for the effects mixer; music silent by manifest duration (declared)

findings: all six input loaders read their folders from the main bundle's resources when it is an .app (as the macOS packaging installs them): the first run found no manifest.json until the folders were installed at the app root
simctl did not forward the app's stdout (--console-pty returned early, --console printed only the pid); --events-file PATH redirects the session's event lines to a file

the simulator's CoreAudio aborted the app at engine setup ('Initialize: RPC timeout. Apparently deadlocked. Aborting now.') with and without an audio session and a deferred start; scripted muted runs therefore open no output (declared); interactive runs start the engine
the session starts on the next main-loop turn after the scene connects

results.scenarios: 9/10 equal to the frozen references (playback as on main)
results.frames: 15,960/15,960 identical to the AppKit app's (per-body digests and PNGs, text included)

gates: macOS release build and Linux musl build still compile; macOS SDL builds with the shared OriginalHIDKeys
open: a real iPad (audio, touch feel, memory: the desktop soak footprint is about 2 GB)
touch controls beyond the mouse mapping
an Xcode project / signing for devices
